data.body: Scratch-bucket proof (2026-10-30, frontier profile, us-east-1, git-remote-s3 0.4.2, real rebar _ref_lock from this change; 6 clones racing per round, 5 rounds each). Winners per round: acquire on absent [1,1,1,1,1] (losers RefLockHeldError); acquire on released marker [1,1,1,1,1]; renew vs steal [1,1,1,1,1] (loser LeaseLostError, final owner matched winner); release vs steal [1,1,1,1,1] (release won 2 rounds, a steal won 3; final owner matched the winner each round, no double success); last-pass-style CAS [1,1,1,1,1]; gate set [1,1,1,1,1] (losers RefLockError); gate clear [1,1,1,1,1]. Bundle size per ref: 700 B at 1 update, 3,362 at 10, 15,249 at 50, 30,111 at 100, 59,812 at 200 (~300 B per update, linear). Bucket rebar-reflock-proof-20261030-65e043 deleted (head-bucket 404).
